title: Yau's uniformization conjecture

result.label: Yau's uniformization conjecture
result.statement: Proves Yau's uniformization conjecture: every complete connected noncompact Kähler manifold with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to ℂ n .
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
